analogy.rationale: Isoleucyl-tRNA synthetase inhibition blocks aminoacylation of tRNA and thereby stalls ribosomal protein synthesis, so other translation inhibitors should share the downstream amino-acid-starvation/translation-stress program. Bacterial ribosomal subunit inhibitors act on the same pathway but in prokaryotes, giving weaker similarity in human cells.
